scenes.title: Power
scenes.summary: Power has the characters of wealth and better ones: those in power are fonder of honor and manlier, more diligent and more dignified, and do wrong on a large scale.

scenes.title: Good Fortune
scenes.summary: Good fortune has the characters of the goods it brings, and makes men arrogant and thoughtless but also lovers of the gods; the characters of the poor, the unfortunate and the powerless follow from the opposites.
